bullets.text: Chennai police humiliated economist A Kalaiyarasan over a fake social media post, and the office should monitor police actions regarding social media cases.
Gummidipoondi traders detained a highways department vehicle over footpath vending issues, and the local administration should intervene to resolve the dispute.
L&T's Vyoma.AI performed a groundbreaking ceremony for its 52-megawatt data centre project in Chennai, and the portfolio team should track project progress.
Noida Authority approved the plan to develop an AI City-cum-business park, and the ministry should observe competing national AI hub developments.

stories.title: Cops whisk away, humiliate economist over fake social media post
takeaways: Chennai-based economist A Kalaiyarasan was whisked away from his Adyar residence by cops over a social media post.
The early-morning incident raises severe concerns about law enforcement conduct and freedom of expression within the constituency.

stories.title: L&T performs groundbreaking for its data centre project in Chennai
takeaways: L&T's AI cloud and hyperscale data center business, Vyoma.AI, held a groundbreaking ceremony for its 52-megawatt project.
The major infrastructure investment strengthens Chennai's position as a leading digital and AI hub.

stories.title: Noida AI City Plan Gets Authority Board Approval
takeaways: Noida Authority approved plans for developing an AI City-cum-business park and an integrated automobile complex.
This marks a competitive national development in AI infrastructure that policymakers in Tamil Nadu should monitor.
